comments.text:
📌 Which of the 30 facts broke your brain the most? For me it’s the island with no rivers: the rain just vanishes underground. 🤯 Tell me in the replies, and if you’ve been to Barbados, what did I miss?

Every fact has a source link in the description, so you can check it yourself. 🔎

comments.author: @Dumou-f9d
comments.text: Simply making a video does not make something factual. Your explanation about Barbados is incomplete and misleading. Having no permanent rivers does not mean having no natural water systems. Barbados has natural gullies, underground water reserves, and systems for rainwater drainage. If your intention is to educate people, then present complete facts backed by proper research instead of spreading half-truths. Knowledge comes from research, not just making videos and presenting assumptions as facts
